info.name: Amazon Application Discovery Service Agents Exports API
Amazon Application Discovery Service Start Export Task

items.docs: Begins the export of discovered data to an S3 bucket. If you specify agentIds in a filter, the task exports up to 72 hours of detailed data collected by the identified Application Discovery Agent, including network, process, and performance details.

info.name: Amazon Application Discovery Service Describe Export Tasks

items.docs: Retrieve status of one or more export tasks. You can retrieve the status of up to 100 export tasks.

info.name: Amazon Application Discovery Service Start Continuous Export

items.docs: Start the continuous flow of agent's discovered data into Amazon Athena.

info.name: Amazon Application Discovery Service Stop Continuous Export

items.docs: Stop the continuous flow of agent's discovered data into Amazon Athena.

info.name: Amazon Application Discovery Service Describe Continuous Exports

items.docs: Lists exports as specified by ID. All continuous exports associated with your user can be listed if you call DescribeContinuousExports as is without passing any parameters.
